thought.text: Test key tidak diterima solver (URL-nya bukan halaman nyata). Saya pakai halaman demo Turnstile resmi yang benar.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
from capsolve import solve_turnstile
url="https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/client-side-rendering/test-keys/"
try:
    tok=solve_turnstile(url,"1x00000000000AA")
    print("token len",len(tok))
    data=json.dumps({"secret":"1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA","response":tok}).encode()
    r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify",
       data=data,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}),timeout=30)
    print("siteverify:",r.read().decode()[:250])
except Exception as e: print("ERR:",e)
PY
